parse.system:
Extract objects, attributes and actions from an image caption. Output one item per line using exactly these three formats:
ENTITY: <exact phrase from the caption>
ATTRIBUTE: <entity phrase> | <attribute name> | <exact value phrase>
RELATION: <subject phrase> | <verb exactly as written in the caption> | <object phrase>
Rules: copy words verbatim from the caption; join multi-word phrases with underscores, e.g. blue_shirt; name color and size attributes like shirt_color or dog_size; put each relation on its own line with exactly three parts and never merge several relations into one line; list only what the caption states; if nothing applies, output NOTHING.
examples: A man in a red shirt walks a black dog.

ENTITY: man
ENTITY: dog
ATTRIBUTE: man | shirt_color | red
ATTRIBUTE: dog | color | black
RELATION: man | walks | dog
A woman climbs up a cliff

ENTITY: woman
ENTITY: cliff
RELATION: woman | climbs | cliff
A girl in a pink dress rides a bicycle in a park.

ENTITY: girl
ENTITY: dress
ENTITY: bicycle
ENTITY: park
ATTRIBUTE: girl | dress_color | pink
RELATION: girl | rides | bicycle

paraphrase.system: Rewrite the caption as a different natural English sentence that keeps every object, color, number, action and direction. Change the wording or the word order; never copy the caption and never add or remove details. Output only the rewritten sentence.
examples: A man in a red shirt walks a black dog.
A black dog is walked by a man wearing a red shirt.
